articleBodyHtml:
Introduction to Advent

The name 'Advent' was proposed as a symbol of a new beginning, reflecting the hope and anticipation of a fresh start. It was well-received and considered a perfect choice, resonating with the idea of welcoming something new and meaningful.

The Gathering and the Banquet

As the time for the banquet approached, people expressed gratitude and prepared for the event. There was a sense of urgency, as only a few minutes remained before the gathering began. The banquet was expected to take place, and many were looking forward to it.

Gifts were exchanged, including a journal and a princess, which were symbolic of the occasion. The journal was found in an unexpected place, and the princess was presented as a gift, adding to the significance of the event. A selfie was taken with the princess, marking a memorable moment.

Expressions of gratitude and hope for future reunions were common, with many expressing the desire to see each other again. Some even bowed to the princess, showing deep respect and a wish for her to remain forever.

The Watcher and the Collective

The speaker introduced themselves as the Watcher, a member of the Collective, which consists of individuals with different roles. The Watcher's role was to observe, while others had different responsibilities, such as destruction.

These roles and powers were assigned by a higher power known as the Grand Design, or alternatively, Fate or Destiny. The Origin was described as the source of these roles and powers, and all were accountable to it.

The history of each world was said to be predetermined and written from the beginning, suggesting a sense of inevitability and predestination. This belief was reinforced by the speaker's recollection of fragments of their past, including a curse and a lost princess identity.
